quantifier_certificate.sectors: All interval starts and lengths reduce to the three sectors by quarter-turn symmetry and reversal; polynomial identities are checked over QQ, not on a grid.
quantifier_certificate.power_sums: Zero initial value and F(M+1)-F(M)=M^q prove every natural M by induction.
quantifier_certificate.inequalities: Shifted-polynomial coefficients certify every B>=2; monotonicity handles 0<=u<B and 1<=d<B.
quantifier_certificate.rounding: Exact Euclidean division proves the coefficient ceilings and coefficient/remainder floors for arbitrary integer inputs.
quantifier_certificate.scope: The standalone checker verifies this symbolic certificate and replays the nonenumerative arithmetic. The report supplies the circuit, interval-reduction, rectangle-rule, and finite-group arguments. Lean checks the sector inequalities and power-sum identities, not the complete quantum proposition.

result_scope: Independent universal verification of the prescribed-probability order trial, with a sharp algebraic strengthening of its integral lower bound.
